picks.intervention_label: daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) on NCT05379985 (or NCT06445062 chemo-combo platform)
picks.rationale: The on-axis swing for KRAS G12R. The NEJM 2026 RMC-6236-001 readout in 2L RAS G12 PDAC at 300 mg gives ORR 35%, mPFS 8.5 mo, mOS 13.1 mo (n=26) — that effect size is multiples of the 2L SoC ceiling and lands directly on the patient's G12R allele via the RAS(ON) mechanism. Preclinical activity is replicated across G12R-bearing PDAC lines (Holderfield, Jiang) and the G12R-specific biology (Hobbs) puts this allele squarely in the tri-complex window rather than the covalent G12C window. Combination with mFOLFIRINOX or gem/nab on NCT06445062 is the higher-ceiling variant given the patient is oxaliplatin-naive — that is the risktaker's preferred lane.
primary_concerns: Class-effect rash (any-grade 91%, grade 3+ 8%), GI toxicity, stomatitis — manageable but real
G12R-specific subgroup ORR not separately reported; the 35% estimate is pooled across G12X
RASolute-302 phase 3 is active-not-recruiting; access to RMC-6236-001 PDAC cohort or the combo platform is the gating axis
Durability beyond ~8 mo PFS is the open question and the relapse-driver in KPC was MYC amplification (Wasko)

picks.intervention_label: zoldonrasib (RMC-7977) + ivonescimab (PD-1×VEGF bispecific) on NCT07397338
picks.rationale: Two-axis swing that the patient otherwise has no route to: pan-RAS(ON) blockade plus a PD-1×VEGF bispecific layered onto an MSS, sub-10-TMB tumor that is biomarker-excluded from every standard ICI label. RMC-7977 in the autochthonous KPC GEMM produced the longest survival extension recorded for that model with complete radiologic responses in a subset (Wasko Nature 2024) — the preclinical effect size is in a different weight class from anything chemo delivers. The ivonescimab layer addresses the immune-cold PDAC barrier that the Singhi 2025 G12R-distinctive microenvironment data suggest may be more amenable to ICI in G12R than in G12D. Thin evidence — no PDAC-specific clinical readout yet, PDAC cohort openness on this trial is uncertain — but the mechanism stack matches the case features cleaner than any other accessible option.
primary_concerns: No published clinical PDAC efficacy for RMC-7977 + ivonescimab — entirely preclinical and cross-tumor extrapolation
PDAC cohort may not be open on this trial; primary indications listed are NSCLC and CRC
Stacking pan-RAS class toxicity (rash, GI) with ICI-class immune-mediated AEs raises grade 3+ event risk
KPC GEMM is G12D, not G12R — class extrapolation but not allele-matched

picks.intervention_label: avutometinib (RAF/MEK clamp) + defactinib (FAKi) + gem/nab-paclitaxel (RAMP-205, NCT05669482)
picks.rationale: 5 of 6 confirmed PRs at dose level 1 (ORR 83%) in 1L KRAS-mutant metastatic PDAC is a striking single-arm signal even at n=6 — this is precisely the kind of early phase hit the risktaker frame is built for. The mechanism stacks RAF/MEK clamp downstream of KRAS, FAK blockade of the immunosuppressive stromal barrier (Jiang 2016 KPC), and cytotoxic chemo on the oxaliplatin-naive backbone the patient still has available. Cross-tumor validation in KRAS-mutant recurrent LGSOC gave 44% ORR with 22-month mPFS (Banerjee JCO 2025), which is unusual durability for a MAPK-axis combo. Major caveats: 1L untreated metastatic indication versus the patient's recurrent post-adjuvant status, and the trial is active-not-recruiting — but the FDA orphan designation and the deep early signal justify the access-pursuit attempt.
primary_concerns: RAMP-205 active not recruiting — enrollment access is the gating issue, not biology
Line mismatch: trial is 1L untreated metastatic, patient is recurrent post-adjuvant FOLFIRI (some protocols count adjuvant chemo as prior systemic, which would exclude)
n=6 at dose level 1 is too small to anchor a stable ORR estimate; small-N regression-to-the-mean risk
Stacking RAF/MEK + FAKi + cytotoxic chemo carries cumulative GI / cytopenia / rash toxicity

picks.intervention_label: anvumetostat (AMG 193, MTA-cooperative PRMT5i) + daraxonrasib or chemo (NCT06360354) — gated on confirming MTAP co-deletion with CDKN2A
picks.rationale: Two of the patient's targetable features hit at once if MTAP is co-deleted with the CDKN2A locus (the 9p21 co-deletion happens in ~80-90% of CDKN2A homozygous deletions). The MTA-cooperative PRMT5 class has a >70-fold therapeutic window over MTAP-WT tissue (Smith MRTX1719 Cancer Discov 2023) and the underlying synthetic-lethal biology (Mavrakis / Kryukov back-to-back Science 2016) is one of the cleanest preclinical foundations in the field. Combining anvumetostat with daraxonrasib on the same trial covers the KRAS axis and the MTAP-loss axis on a single regimen — the kind of combinatorial double-hit the risktaker frame favors. Caveat: requires MTAP reflex testing first; if MTAP is retained, this pivot falls.
primary_concerns: Gated on MTAP co-deletion confirmation — not yet on file; add MTAP IHC or NGS copy-number reflex
PDAC representation in the clinical PRMT5i programs is still small; most published activity is in NSCLC / mesothelioma
First-generation PRMT5 inhibitors had dose-limiting hematologic toxicity; class-spare claim rests on the MTA-cooperative chemistry holding up in humans
MountainTAP-5 (NCT07492680) is not-yet-recruiting (July 2026 start) — access window is later than the daraxonrasib lanes

picks.intervention_label: palbociclib + MEK/ERK or IGF1R combination via ADOPT PDO-guided platform (NCT06813079) or off-label combo on CDKN2A-loss / CCND3 rationale
picks.rationale: CDKN2A loss plus a CCND3 alteration is the textbook CDK4/6-axis case, and the Knudsen 2023 Cancer Research data show synergistic suppression in all six PDAC organoids tested when CDK4/6 is combined with MEK or ERK blockade — the bypass routes (cyclin D, MYC, mTOR) are what kill the single agent. NCI-MATCH Z1C palbociclib monotherapy in CDK4/6-amplified solid tumors gave ORR 4% (PMID 39437014), so the monotherapy lane is dead; the combination lane has not been adequately tested in CDKN2A-loss-selected PDAC and the upside-to-downside ratio of trying it under PDO guidance (ADOPT) is favorable. The risktaker tolerates the thin clinical evidence here because the mechanism stack maps the patient's biomarker set exactly and the toxicity profile (neutropenia, manageable) does not violate the patient's no-veto preference.
primary_concerns: Single-agent CDK4/6i in CDKN2A-altered solid tumors has consistently underperformed — combination strategy is preclinical-rationale-only in PDAC
ADOPT is not-yet-recruiting; off-label combination requires institutional pharmacy support and is not a registered trial
G12R-specific CDK4/6 data are absent; Singhi 2025 lower-ERK G12R phenotype may shift CDK4/6 + MEK synergy expectations
Neutropenia and cumulative cytopenia risk when stacking with chemo or MEKi

notes: Ranking by potential effect size per risktaker frame. Pick 1 (daraxonrasib) is the load-bearing on-axis option with the only published meaningful clinical effect size in this allele (PMID 42090791). Picks 2-5 trade thinner evidence for higher mechanism-stack ceilings — the user's accept-high-risk-high-reward stance and 0.80 efficacy weight justifies the order. Olaparib / PARPi excluded from ranked picks because the case has no germline / somatic HRD data on file yet (gated by target_validation germline-pdac-hboc-lynch-lfs-panel) and the patient was adjuvant-FOLFIRI (no platinum induction); same for eprenetapopt (TP53 variant class not yet annotated as missense / hotspot). ELI-002 7P vaccine excluded from ranked picks because the patient is overt-recurrent rather than MRD-positive resected, so NCT05726864 eligibility window has likely closed despite the clean G12R-mechanism fit; logged here for the team. No hard toxicity-veto conflicts identified.

picks.intervention_label: daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) monotherapy on NCT05379985
picks.rationale: Cleanest fit for what the patient actually asked for. Recruiting trial, oral once-daily, and the Wolpin NEJM 2026 cohort at 300 mg in 2L RAS G12 PDAC delivered ORR 35%, mPFS 8.5 mo, mOS 13.1 mo with G12R inside the G12X estimand — that is the best published efficacy on this allele anywhere, which matters when the patient is treating to remission with a 0.80 efficacy weight. Grade 3+ TRAEs around 30% with rash and GI as the class effects sit well inside what a no-vetoes patient has consented to. The one screening gate is the orthogonal NGS or ctDNA G12R confirmation in target_validation.jsonl, and that workup is already scoped.
primary_concerns: Satisfied: prefers_trials (recruiting), efficacy-lean weight, treat-to-remission framing, no toxicity vetoes triggered
Open: G12R-specific subgroup ORR is not separately published — the field reads G12X as a pooled estimand pending phase 3
Open: requires baseline G12R confirmation on orthogonal NGS / ctDNA before trial entry

picks.intervention_label: daraxonrasib + mFOLFIRINOX or gem/nab on NCT06445062 (RMC-GI-102)
picks.rationale: If treat to remission is the load-bearing phrase in preferences.json, this is the route that takes that goal at face value. The patient is oxaliplatin-naive (adjuvant FOLFIRI only), so an mFOLFIRINOX combination arm is biologically available, and the RAMP-205 dose-level-1 ASCO 2024 readout of 5/6 confirmed PRs on a chemo-plus-targeted backbone shows what depth of response combination intensification can produce in RAS-mutant PDAC. Stacking pan-RAS-class toxicity (rash, GI) on chemo-class toxicity (cytopenia, neuropathy) is real, and the patient accepts that trade — accepts high-risk-high-reward is in the free text. Sponsor confirmation that the PDAC subprotocol is open at the patient's referral site is the operational gate.
primary_concerns: Satisfied: prefers_trials, efficacy-lean weight, high-risk-high-reward explicitly invited
Open: PDAC arm openness varies by site — sponsor / treating team confirmation needed
Open: prior adjuvant FOLFIRI may push the chemo backbone choice toward gem/nab rather than mFOLFIRINOX depending on residual neuropathy

picks.intervention_label: zoldonrasib (RMC-7977) + ivonescimab (PD-1×VEGF bispecific) on NCT07397338
picks.rationale: Highest-ceiling option on the table and the only route that touches the immune axis a G12R MSS tumor otherwise has no access to. The Wasko Nature 2024 KPC data show RMC-7977 producing complete radiologic responses in a subset of an autochthonous PDAC model, and the Singhi 2025 finding that G12R-mutant PDAC carries a relatively immune-enriched microenvironment makes the PD-1 × VEGF layer biologically more interesting in G12R than in G12D. The patient said treat to remission and accepts high-risk-high-reward, which is the consent framework this regimen needs. Honest weakness: the trial's primary listed indications are NSCLC and CRC, so PDAC cohort access is the operational gate before any of this is real.
primary_concerns: Satisfied: prefers_trials, efficacy-lean weight, free_text treat-to-remission and accept high-risk-high-reward both honored
Open: PDAC cohort openness on a NSCLC / CRC-primary trial — confirm before screening labs
Open: combination-toxicity envelope of RAS(ON) + PD-1×VEGF is not yet mature; no published PDAC clinical readout

picks.intervention_label: PF-07934040 pan-KRAS small molecule on NCT06447662
picks.rationale: Backup-route option that names G12R explicitly in the inclusion criteria rather than burying it in pan-codon-12 language — that specificity matters when the patient is being matched to a trial. The protocol carries both a 2L+ monotherapy cohort (Part 2a Cohort A1) that fits the recurrent post-adjuvant status and a 1L gem/nab combo arm if the team prefers a chemo backbone. Pfizer has not published clinical efficacy yet, so this is a class-extrapolation pick that rides on the daraxonrasib precedent. Watch-item: grade 2+ sensory neuropathy is an exclusion, which matters given prior FOLFIRI.
primary_concerns: Satisfied: prefers_trials, efficacy-lean weight, G12R explicitly named in eligibility
Open: no published efficacy data for PF-07934040 — class-extrapolation from RMC-6236
Open: residual neuropathy from prior FOLFIRI must clear the grade 2 exclusion threshold

picks.intervention_label: anvumetostat (AMG 193) + daraxonrasib on NCT06360354, gated on confirming MTAP co-deletion
picks.rationale: The single trial that hits both the KRAS G12R axis and the CDKN2A-loss axis if MTAP is co-deleted on the same 9p21 allele — and that co-deletion runs at 80-90% in CDKN2A homozygous loss. For a remission-seeking patient, attacking two of the targetable features at once is the kind of mechanistic concentration the preference set rewards. Preclinical foundation is unusually clean: Mavrakis 2016, Kryukov 2016, Smith MRTX1719 2023 with >70-fold MTAP-deleted selectivity sparing the hematologic toxicity that killed first-generation PRMT5 inhibitors. Gating step is an MTAP IHC or NGS copy-number reflex on the existing tumor block — cheap to order, decisive to read.
primary_concerns: Satisfied: prefers_trials, efficacy-lean weight, dual-feature targeting consistent with treat-to-remission framing
Open: MTAP co-deletion status not on file — needs reflex testing before enrollment
Open: phase 1b combination toxicity envelope still in dose-finding — anvumetostat plus RMC-6236 has limited public safety data

notes: Preferences are unusually permissive: no toxicity vetoes, no modality constraints, efficacy_toxicity_weight 0.80, treat to remission as the stated goal, accepts high-risk-high-reward, prefers trials. The whole top 5 leans into the trial axis because that is what the patient asked for, and the ranking is biased toward deepest-response options rather than safest ones. Olaparib maintenance (POLO, PMID 31157963) is deliberately not in the top 5 because both germline testing and a platinum induction are upstream gates — if germline BRCA1/2 or PALB2 turns positive on the workup in target_validation.jsonl row germline-pdac-hboc-lynch-lfs-panel, the board should revisit. ELI-002 7P (NCT05726864) is excluded from ranked picks because the patient is overt-recurrent rather than MRD-positive resected, so the eligibility window has likely closed despite a clean G12R mechanism fit. Eprenetapopt is excluded because the TP53 variant class is not yet annotated as missense / hotspot. Standard-of-care chemo (FOLFIRINOX, NALIRIFOX, gem/nab) is out of scope under the targetable-feature rule and is the treating team's call independent of this board.

picks.intervention_label: daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) monotherapy on NCT05379985 or expanded access if available
picks.rationale: Only indication-matched on-axis evidence in the dossier, and even this sits at ROBINS-I Moderate. Wolpin NEJM 2026 reports ORR 35% / mPFS 8.5 / mOS 13.1 in 2L RAS G12 PDAC at 300 mg, but the load-bearing efficacy number comes from n=26 in a pooled G12 cohort with no G12R-specific allele-resolved breakdown published. Phase 3 RASolute 302 (NCT06625320) is active not recruiting with no OS readout reported, so the registrational benchmark is still pending. Preclinical activity across G12X alleles including G12R is consistent (Holderfield 2024 Nature, Jiang 2024 Cancer Discovery), but mechanism-class plausibility does not substitute for the phase 3 result that has not landed.
primary_concerns: ROBINS-I D1 (confounding): single-arm open-label phase 1/2 with sponsor-only analysis; no concurrent comparator
ROBINS-I D5 (deviations from intended intervention): open-label outcome ascertainment for ORR; no central blinded review described in the available report
ROBINS-I D7 (selective reporting): G12R-specific subgroup ORR not separately published; G12 pooling obscures the allele-resolved estimand
Power: n=26 in the 2L RAS G12 cohort at 300 mg is underpowered to estimate the G12R-only effect with useful precision

Cross-mutation extrapolation: sotorasib (Strickler 2023) and adagrasib (Bekaii-Saab 2023) PDAC G12C readouts do not transpose onto G12R because G12R is GTP-loaded and structurally distinct (Hobbs 2020)
Phase 3 has not read out: RASolute 302 OS data are not yet on file; registrational confirmation is pending

picks.intervention_label: olaparib maintenance after platinum induction, contingent on germline BRCA / PALB2
picks.rationale: Only phase-3 RCT in the dossier with RoB2:Low and a pre-specified primary endpoint met at conventional alpha (POLO, HR 0.53 for PFS, p=0.004). Also the only molecular-selection pathway here grounded in randomized evidence. The case has no germline panel on file and no platinum exposure since adjuvant FOLFIRI was irinotecan-only, so both gates have to open before this pathway exists. Note also that the POLO interim OS HR was 0.91 (NS), so the PFS benefit has not translated to an OS signal even in the registrational cohort.
primary_concerns: Biomarker gate open: case has no germline BRCA1/2/PALB2 result; target_validation row 'germline-pdac-hboc-lynch-lfs-panel' is the rate-limiting workup
Treatment-sequence gate open: patient is platinum-naive (adjuvant FOLFIRI is irinotecan-based), so the POLO entry condition (no progression after >=16 wk first-line platinum) is not satisfied
Endpoint hierarchy: POLO interim OS HR 0.91 with no separation; the PFS hit has not converted to OS
Rucaparib extension (Reiss 2021, pmid:33970687) is single-arm n=42 with PFS-rate as primary endpoint; supports the class but does not on its own clear an RCT-level bar

picks.intervention_label: PF-07934040 (NCT06447662) or ASP5834 (NCT07094204) pan-KRAS phase 1 with explicit G12R inclusion
picks.rationale: Phase 1 dose-escalation programs that name G12R explicitly in eligibility, which is logistically distinctive in a field that mostly writes pooled codon-12 language. No efficacy data are published. Listed here as trial-search redundancy if a daraxonrasib slot is unavailable, plus a different RAS-targeting mechanism (small-molecule pan-KRAS or IV degrader) that may carve a tolerability window the tri-complex class does not. There is no clinical efficacy signal yet, so this is access-positioning rather than evidence-ranked.
primary_concerns: No efficacy readout: phase 1 dose-finding only
No published toxicity profile beyond protocol exclusions (e.g. grade 2+ neuropathy excluded from PF-07934040)
Mechanism class is plausible but unconfirmed in PDAC G12R
Sample sizes at PDAC-specific dose levels will be small and exploratory

notes: Several dossier rows did not clear a RoB / ROBINS-I screen for inclusion in the top picks. Palbociclib monotherapy: NCI-MATCH Z1C (O'Hara 2025, pmid:39437014) returned ORR 4% across CDK4/6-amplified solid tumors, so the closest published basket precedent for off-label use in a CDKN2A-loss / CCND3 case is actively negative; CAPTUR Group 8 and NCI-MATCH Z1F arms that would speak more directly to CDKN2A loss have not read out. ELI-002 (AMPLIFY-201 / 7P): published data are phase 1, n=25, single-arm, ROBINS-I:Serious, with an enrollment window of MRD-positive resected disease; the patient is overt-recurrent and out of scope. Avutometinib + defactinib + gem/nab (RAMP 205): the 83% ORR figure is an ASCO 2024 abstract at dose level 1 with n=6, no full publication, ROBINS-I:Serious; that is signal-finding, not evidence. PaTcH (trametinib + HCQ) closed for futility, which downweights the MEK + autophagy basket (NTO-RAS) until it produces its own data. The G12C-selective readouts (sotorasib, adagrasib in PDAC) are off-target at the molecular level for a G12R patient, and the G12D-selective phase 3 programs (DAWN-303, ASP3082) exclude G12R by design. SoC chemotherapy (FOLFIRINOX, NALIRIFOX, gem/nab, nal-IRI) is excluded under Libby's targetable-feature scope rule because none of those regimens target the patient's molecular features. The MSS / TMB 4.1 combination forecloses tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab cleanly (Marabelle 2020 KEYNOTE-158) and the dual-ICI plus chemo path failed in the indication (Renouf 2022 PA.7, RoB2:Low, p=0.72); both are decision-relevant negatives rather than candidates. Net: one indication-matched phase 1/2 single-arm with a load-bearing 26-patient subgroup, one phase 3 RCT the patient is not currently eligible for, and a set of phase 1 programs with no efficacy readouts. From a strict RCT-grade-evidence stance this case has no comfortable answer.

picks.intervention_label: daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) on RMC-6236-001 / RMC-GI-102 / RASolute 302 (NCT05379985, NCT06445062, NCT06625320)
picks.rationale: Clinical-trial enrollment is the route NCCN Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma v2.2026 endorses for recurrent disease whenever an actionable alteration is identified, and daraxonrasib is the agent that maps onto a confirmed KRAS G12R. Wolpin NEJM 2026 reports ORR 35%, mPFS 8.5 mo, mOS 13.1 mo in 2L RAS G12 PDAC at 300 mg, and RASolute 302 interim hazard ratios drove FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation. Pan-RAS is not yet listed in any NCCN evidence category for PDAC, so this pick rides on the NCCN-endorsed trial-enrollment principle rather than a 2A drug-level recommendation; ESMO MCBS has not yet scored the class.
primary_concerns: Pan-RAS is not an NCCN-listed regimen for PDAC; the guideline-fit case rests on the NCCN trial-enrollment principle and the FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation, not a category 1 or 2A drug-level endorsement.
RASolute 302 is active not recruiting; access is more likely through RMC-GI-102 (NCT06445062) or RMC-6236-001 (NCT05379985) than the registrational trial.
G12R-specific subgroup ORR has not been published as a separate estimand; the 35% number is pooled across G12X.

picks.intervention_label: olaparib maintenance after platinum induction, gated on germline BRCA1/2 panel (POLO regimen)
picks.rationale: NCCN Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma v2.2026 recommends germline testing for every PDAC patient regardless of family history and lists olaparib maintenance as a category 1 option for germline BRCA1/2-mutant metastatic disease after at least 16 weeks of platinum without progression. POLO (Golan 2019 NEJM, PFS HR 0.53) is the load-bearing RCT and ESMO accepts the same indication. The patient has no germline data on file and had FOLFIRI adjuvant (irinotecan-based, no platinum), so a platinum induction would have to come first; two gating workups sit between the pick and a usable plan, but the guideline endorsement on the other side is as strong as PDAC offers.
primary_concerns: Germline status is unknown; the entire pathway is contingent on the germline panel returning a pathogenic BRCA1, BRCA2, or PALB2 variant.

Patient is platinum-naive after FOLFIRI adjuvant. A NALIRIFOX or FOLFIRINOX induction (treating team handles SoC; outside Libby's scope) would need to deliver disease control for at least 16 weeks before the POLO indication opens.
Rucaparib (Reiss 2021 JCO) extends the signal to somatic BRCA / PALB2 but is not yet category 1 in NCCN PDAC.

picks.intervention_label: PF-07934040 pan-KRAS small molecule on NCT06447662
picks.rationale: Pfizer's pan-KRAS inhibitor explicitly names G12R in its eligibility criteria, which is unusual among the first-in-human pan-KRAS programs and is the second-option after daraxonrasib if RMC-6236 access is blocked. Trial-enrollment principle (NCCN Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma v2.2026, preferred when an actionable alteration is identified) is what aligns this pick with the guideline; the agent itself has no NCCN drug-level listing and ESMO has not scored the class. Phase 1 is recruiting with both a 2L+ PDAC monotherapy cohort (Part 2a A1) matching the patient's post-FOLFIRI status and a 1L gem/nab combination arm.
primary_concerns: Phase 1; no mature efficacy data published yet, RP2D in the PDAC cohort is still being established.
Grade 2+ sensory neuropathy is an exclusion; prior FOLFIRI raises the neuropathy watch-item even though irinotecan-based regimens are generally neuropathy-sparing.
Not an NCCN-listed or ESMO-scored regimen for PDAC; ranks below daraxonrasib only because the clinical-data depth is lower.

picks.intervention_label: ELI-002 7P amphiphile mKRAS peptide vaccine (AMPLIFY-7P, NCT05726864)
picks.rationale: ELI-002 7P explicitly covers G12R in its peptide panel and the AMPLIFY-201 final report (Wainberg 2025 Nat Med) showed ctDNA reduction in 21/25 MRD-positive patients with durable T-cell responses. NCCN Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma v2.2026 does not list any KRAS vaccine as a category 1 or 2A recommendation; the trial-enrollment principle is again the guideline-aligned framing. AMPLIFY-7P enrolls resected adjuvant MRD-positive disease, which is outside the patient's recurrent-overt-disease setting, and the trial is active not recruiting.
primary_concerns: Patient is overt-recurrent, not adjuvant MRD-only; AMPLIFY-7P inclusion criteria likely exclude this setting.
Trial status is active not recruiting, so access is the binding constraint even if the eligibility window were open.
No NCCN or ESMO category for KRAS vaccines in PDAC; this pick is mechanism-fit plus trial-enrollment-principle alignment, not a guideline-listed regimen.

picks.intervention_label: anvumetostat (AMG 193) PRMT5 inhibitor on MTAPESTRY-103 (NCT06360354), gated on MTAP co-deletion
picks.rationale: CDKN2A and MTAP are adjacent on 9p21 and co-deleted in roughly 80-90% of CDKN2A homozygous deletions; the MTA-cooperative PRMT5 class (Mavrakis 2016 Science, Kryukov 2016 Science, Smith 2023 Cancer Discovery for MRTX1719) is the synthetic-lethal axis tied to this patient's CDKN2A loss. NCT06360354 includes a combination arm with daraxonrasib that would hit both the KRAS G12R and the CDKN2A-loss / MTAP-deletion features in a single trial. NCCN Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma v2.2026 has no MTAP-deletion line item; trial enrollment is again the guideline-aligned route.
primary_concerns: MTAP co-deletion status has not been confirmed for this patient; the rationale collapses if MTAP is retained.
MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitors are early-phase across all indications; PDAC-specific efficacy data are not yet published.
No NCCN evidence category exists for this class in PDAC; pick rides on biomarker-and-trial alignment, not a drug-level endorsement.

notes: Standard-of-care chemotherapy (FOLFIRINOX, NALIRIFOX, gem/nab-paclitaxel, nal-IRI/5FU) is excluded by the targetable-feature scope rule even though NCCN Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma v2.2026 lists those as category 1 / 2A for recurrent disease; they do not target the listed features and are the treating team's call independent of Libby. Single-agent CDK4/6 inhibition for CDKN2A loss plus CCND3 alteration was considered but is not guideline-listed for PDAC, and the NCI-MATCH Z1C palbociclib basket (O'Hara 2025 CCR, ORR 4%) reads as a negative precedent in CDK4/6-amplified solid tumors. ICI is foreclosed by MSS plus TMB 4.1 against the FDA tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab thresholds (Marabelle 2020 JCO; Renouf 2022 Nat Commun PA.7 negative for biomarker-agnostic ICI on chemo). Avutometinib + defactinib (RAMP 205, NCT05669482) is active not recruiting and is aimed at 1L untreated metastatic rather than recurrent post-adjuvant disease; PaTcH (MEKi + HCQ) closed for futility. Three of five picks ride on the NCCN trial-enrollment principle rather than a drug-level category. That is the guideline framing for an MSS, sub-TMB-threshold, KRAS G12R recurrent PDAC where the actionable-alteration menu is dominated by pre-approval agents.

picks.intervention_label: daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) monotherapy on NCT05379985
picks.rationale: Best-characterized safety profile of any G12R-active option on the board. NEJM 2026 pivotal cohort dosed 168 PDAC patients with any-grade TRAE at 96% and G3+ at 30%, and the AE picture is fully mapped: rash 91% any-grade / 8% G3+, diarrhea 48% / 2% G3+, stomatitis 31% / 3%, nausea 43%, fatigue 20%. These are skin and GI events with routine management algorithms imported from the EGFR-inhibitor playbook (topical steroids plus low-dose doxycycline for rash, loperamide ladder for diarrhea, dexamethasone mouthwash for stomatitis). The 2L RAS G12 subgroup at 300 mg delivered ORR 35% with mPFS 8.5 mo and mOS 13.1 mo (n=26), and G12R sits inside that pooled estimand. No organ-failure signals reported across the 168-patient denominator, no DLT-class surprises across the dose-escalation.
primary_concerns: G12R-specific subgroup ORR is not yet broken out from the pooled G12X estimand — the 35% number is allele-pooled
Longest-followed patients are at roughly 2 years; the conservative-default 5-year safety threshold is not met for the pan-RAS class
Rash and stomatitis management adds visit burden but is not dose-limiting at 300 mg

picks.intervention_label: olaparib 300 mg PO BID maintenance after platinum induction — contingent on germline BRCA1/2 result
picks.rationale: Most mature safety dataset in the candidate set. POLO is a RoB2-low phase 3 RCT, FDA-approved in 2019, with 7 years of post-marketing surveillance in PDAC and a deeper PARP-class safety record from the ovarian and breast labels. G3+ AEs 40% on olaparib vs 23% on placebo, AE-driven discontinuation 5%, no fatal events in the registrational arm. Class AEs (anemia, fatigue, nausea, MDS / AML risk at roughly 1.5% on prolonged exposure) have NCCN-published management algorithms. Two hard gates apply: the germline BRCA1/2 / PALB2 panel is not yet on file (target_validation row germline-pdac-hboc-lynch-lfs-panel is the workup), and the patient has had zero platinum exposure because adjuvant FOLFIRI was irinotecan-only. POLO requires at least 16 weeks of first-line platinum without progression as the entry condition.
primary_concerns: Germline BRCA / PALB2 status currently unknown — pathway gates entirely on this result
Platinum induction has not occurred — POLO eligibility requires it as a prerequisite
MDS / AML risk on prolonged PARP exposure is the long-tail signal to monitor at year 2 and beyond

picks.intervention_label: ELI-002 7P amphiphile mKRAS peptide vaccine on NCT05726864
picks.rationale: Cleanest safety profile in the entire dossier. AMPLIFY-201 (n=25, ELI-002 2P, G12D + G12R panel) reported zero DLTs through dose-escalation, no G3+ vaccine-attributed events, with injection-site reactions as the dominant AE class. The 7P successor extends the same amphiphile-peptide chemistry to seven KRAS variants including G12R. Mechanism is immunologic priming with no overlapping toxicity against likely concurrent regimens, which keeps this on the table as an adjunct rather than a primary cytoreductive option. The disqualifying caveat is enrollment scope: the trial enrolls MRD-positive resected disease, and this patient has overt recurrent disease that sits outside the window unless a curative-intent salvage resection becomes feasible. Status is active-not-recruiting per registry, which narrows access further.
primary_concerns: Overt-recurrent disease falls outside the MRD-positive enrollment window — eligibility is the gate, not safety
Active not recruiting per registry — access is the bottleneck
Vaccine effect requires immune competence and a 2-3 month T-cell expansion window; not a bridge for rapidly progressing disease

picks.intervention_label: rucaparib 600 mg PO BID maintenance — contingent on germline or somatic BRCA1/2 or PALB2
picks.rationale: PARP-class backup to olaparib that widens the biomarker net to include somatic BRCA and PALB2. Reiss 2021 phase 2 (n=46) reported mPFS 13.1 mo, mOS 23.5 mo, ORR 41.7% in the measurable-disease subset, with no new safety signals at extended follow-up. AE profile mirrors the olaparib registrational data (fatigue, anemia, nausea) under the same NCCN management framework. Ranked below olaparib because the supporting evidence is phase 2 single-arm rather than RCT, but the toxicity ceiling is the same well-characterized PARP class with the same MDS / AML long-tail. Same gating logic: germline panel plus platinum induction before this becomes operative.
primary_concerns: Phase 2 single-arm rather than phase 3 RCT
Same germline and platinum-exposure gates as olaparib
PARP-class MDS / AML risk applies on prolonged exposure
